claim: Azami defines the present phenotypic field that EAzami must explain
allowed_interpretation: one-way empirical-to-generative dependency
prohibited_interpretation: Azami and EAzami are independent parallel trait projects

claim: The frozen empirical handoff contains 62 exact observational estimands
allowed_interpretation: reproducible compression of present-day phenotype/environment structure
prohibited_interpretation: 62 causal effects

claim: NULL_COUPLED is the robust scalar-target structural-sufficiency winner
allowed_interpretation: best of 14 frozen prior-predictive families for the 62 scalar targets
prohibited_interpretation: true history; climate has no effect

claim: NULL_COUPLED ranks first in all 16 primary paired draws and in min2 sensitivity
allowed_interpretation: stable relative scalar-target ranking under the frozen screen
prohibited_interpretation: posterior probability of NULL

claim: The frozen scalar winner fails the held-out scale-specific support geometry
allowed_interpretation: scalar adequacy does not imply hierarchical inferential adequacy
prohibited_interpretation: PR119 winner is retroactively invalid

claim: Primary held-out support pattern occurs in 0/64 NULL_COUPLED draws
allowed_interpretation: held-out pattern is exceptional under frozen NULL generator
prohibited_interpretation: exact frequentist probability of the true historical null

claim: Among-taxon growing-season-water support is especially poorly reproduced by NULL
allowed_interpretation: mismatch is localized toward among-taxon process information
prohibited_interpretation: GSP is proven causal selective agent

claim: PROCESS_AMONG_ONLY_SHARED_COUPLED improves strongly over NULL but is not adequate
allowed_interpretation: among-only process direction is diagnostically promising but insufficient
prohibited_interpretation: among-only model explains the data

claim: No tested post-heldout addition satisfies the frozen adequacy rule
allowed_interpretation: current tested model family remains incomplete
prohibited_interpretation: all possible environmental histories are rejected

claim: Present-day scalar geometry and historical identifiability are distinct
allowed_interpretation: richer representations of the present can reject histories left admissible by scalar compression
prohibited_interpretation: a universal theorem proven for all biological systems

claim: EAzami should output an admissible-history set rather than a single true history
evidence: sequential frozen constraints and accepted negative results
allowed_interpretation: formal framing of the current workflow
prohibited_interpretation: actual realized evolutionary trajectory already reconstructed

claim: Japan38 nuclear topology requires repeated changes in multiple capitulum traits
evidence: frozen Comp1061 ML + 1000 UFBoot; source-backed trait states
allowed_interpretation: orthogonal realized-history constraint
prohibited_interpretation: repeated adaptive convergence

claim: Simple shared whole-capitulum evolutionary lability is not supported
evidence: reconstruction-aware continuous null plus branch-length-aware and topology-only discrete common-lability analyses
allowed_interpretation: one simple common-lability alternative is disfavored
prohibited_interpretation: genetic/developmental modularity proven

claim: Nuclear population genomics + plastid haplotype + cytotype is the next ancestry discriminator
allowed_interpretation: future test of standing variation vs introgression vs lineage-specific origin
prohibited_interpretation: evidence already collected

claim: Functional adaptation remains a downstream gate
allowed_interpretation: trait-function-fitness requires independent intervention
prohibited_interpretation: image morphology directly equals function

claim: Flower-colour loss/regain is no longer the central Chapter 2 question
allowed_interpretation: retain colour as secondary molecular/historical module
prohibited_interpretation: reopen frozen colour anti-phylogenetic rescue as main story

claim: Registered present-day capitulum integration is stronger within taxa than among taxa
allowed_interpretation: scale-dependent observational integration
prohibited_interpretation: genetic or persistent historical modules

claim: No robust continuous phylogenetic state structure is detected in the current sparse exact-concept panel
evidence: original continuous family plus pre-frozen JPN29 exclusion sensitivity
allowed_interpretation: retain uncertainty and the high-depth not-evaluable outcome
prohibited_interpretation: zero phylogenetic signal or lost conservation

claim: Orientation phyllary posture and stickiness each require repeated minimum changes
evidence: current ML and 1000 UFBoot parsimony outputs
allowed_interpretation: topology-conditioned recurrence lower bounds
prohibited_interpretation: independent origins convergence adaptation or rates

claim: Recurrence-count stability does not imply exact transition-placement identifiability
evidence: forced-edge audits for orientation phyllary and stickiness
allowed_interpretation: counts and branch localization are separate estimands
prohibited_interpretation: every minimum step is a known event

claim: The original continuous branch-change correlation does not exceed the reconstruction-aware null
allowed_interpretation: raw reconstructed-branch coupling remains descriptive even though naive branch permutation gives P≈0.00010
prohibited_interpretation: coordinated evolutionary remodeling

claim: The single frozen JPN29-excluded sensitivity also fails the reconstruction-aware null
allowed_interpretation: identity correction supports the same bounded decision
prohibited_interpretation: replace the original result or prove independence

claim: Positive equal-branch topology signs are estimator-stability diagnostics only
allowed_interpretation: topology perturbation does not substitute for a reconstruction-aware null
prohibited_interpretation: use 1000/1000 signs to rescue shared historical coupling

claim: No discrete pair has consistently positive transition localization across branch-length and topology treatments
allowed_interpretation: one persistent three-trait historical module is unsupported
prohibited_interpretation: fully independent traits or developmental modularity

claim: The active JEB claim is configuration diversity with multiple minimum changes unequal count-depth-edge resolution and bounded explanatory reach
allowed_interpretation: orientation phyllary posture and stickiness have distinct topology-conditioned historical resolution profiles and current data explain them to unequal degrees
prohibited_interpretation: independent origins convergence absolute timing function selection adaptation or complete causal explanation

claim: Exactly three Japan38 discrete histories are currently complete
allowed_interpretation: orientation phyllary posture and stickiness only
prohibited_interpretation: colour display or cytotype as an inferred fourth trait history

claim: Orientation has a stable but unresolved present-day climate correspondence
allowed_interpretation: downward/nodding orientation is associated with higher BIO15 and lower BIO1 across 6/6 accepted topologies and 54/54 species-LOO fits; inferential thresholds remain unresolved
prohibited_interpretation: historical climate causation adaptation or event-specific ecological convergence

claim: Legacy transition fractions are not admissible on the accepted run-329 artifact
evidence: run 328 reproduces 0.201 0.754 0.67 0.40; run 329 plus JPN24 yields current fractions
allowed_interpretation: retain legacy values as superseded audit and use current frozen output for active claims
prohibited_interpretation: attach superseded localization values to current topology or trait matrix

claim: Phyllary posture and stickiness ecology are not evaluable with the current frozen state-by-climate overlap
allowed_interpretation: insufficient state-diverse overlap is an evidence-resolution result
prohibited_interpretation: no ecological relationship or no selective effect

claim: Current non-climate data constrain simple explanations without identifying a cause
allowed_interpretation: one-to-one ploidy and broad-history mappings are contradicted descriptively; population nuclear data constrain species-tip homogeneity; biotic predictors remain not_evaluable as a joined Japan38 matrix
prohibited_interpretation: ploidy independence population causation or absence of biotic effects

claim: The accepted Comp1061 tree is the harmonized full-panel nuclear scaffold but not the only East-Asian nuclear evidence
allowed_interpretation: older rDNA MIG-seq/RAD transcriptome genome and local phylotranscriptomic evidence constrain other scales and interpretations
prohibited_interpretation: pool heterogeneous marker systems into one branch-length tree or call Moreyra 2025 the sole nuclear evidence

claim: Held-out phylogeny-only prediction is a Supporting Information sensitivity rather than the primary ecological-reach gate
allowed_interpretation: retain transparency about predictive diagnostics without overfitting a nine-taxon panel
prohibited_interpretation: require predictive model competition before reporting stable ecological correspondence
